blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Counting how many times something happens is among the simplest questions about a video and among the hardest for video-language models, autoregressive and diffusion alike. The difficulty lies between the frames: a model samples only a few of them, while each repetition unfolds as movement in between. Video codecs already record this movement densely as block displacements, and codec-based video models use it to shape their visual input. We are the first to show that this motion provides direct evidence for the count: a candidate count is a testable motion hypothesis, and unwinding the cycles it implies measures how strongly the observed directions support it. We present CoDiCount, a unified training-free framework that turns this test into a count potential and applies it while a frozen diffusion vision-language model (dVLM) denoises its answer. At every denoising step, structured count messages map each option letter, or each grammar-valid edit of an open integer, to the count it expresses and reweight the model's own probabilities within that set. Consistent gains over the official decoders on MotionBench, TOMATO, and SVCBench demonstrate the broad generalization of CoDiCount across diffusion models, datasets, and diverse counting tasks. With CoDiCount, a 7B dVLM outperforms GPT-5.1 and Gemini-2.5-Pro on MotionBench, surpasses GPT-4o and much larger open models on TOMATO, and matches GPT-5.4 on SVCBench.
blocks.zh: 数数事物发生多少次是最简单的视频问题, 难度在于帧之间:一个模型只取出其中的几个样本,而每一次重复作为运动在两者之间展开. 视频解码器已经记录了这种运动作为块位迁移的密集程度,基于解码器的视频模型用它来塑造他们的视觉输入. 我们首先表明,这项动议为计数提供了直接证据:候选人计数是一种可测试的运动假设,并且解除其意味着衡量所观察到的方向对它的支持程度的周期。 我们提出CoDiCount, 一个统一的无训练框架, 将这个测试变成计数潜力, 在每一个去诺步骤上,结构化的计数信息将每个选项字母,或者每个语法有效的编辑一个开口整数,映射到它表达的计数,并重新加权模型在该集内的自身概率. 在Motion Bench、TOMATO和SVCBench上对官方解码器的一致收益表明,CoDiCount在扩散模型、数据集和各种计数任务中得到了广泛的概括。 与CoDiCount公司,7B dVLM在Motion Bench上的表现优于GPT-5.1和双子座-2.5-Pro,在TOMATO上超越了GPT-4o和更大的开放型号,在SVCBench上与GPT-5.4相匹配.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Counting how many times something happens is among the simplest questions about a video and among the hardest for video-language models.
Recent benchmarks test it as part of fine-grained motion understanding in MotionBench [ 7 ] , temporal reasoning in TOMATO [ 19 ] , and streaming state maintenance in SVCBench [ 14 ] .
On TOMATO, GPT-4o answers only 36.0% of the counting questions correctly [ 19 ] .
On SVCBench, every model evaluated by its authors remains far below the 96.1 of humans on the primary counting metric, and on periodic activities none exceeds 11.1 [ 14 ] .
blocks.zh:
数数事情发生多少次,是最简单的视频问题之一,也是视频语言模型最难处理的问题之一。
近期基准测试它作为精细分解运动理解的一部分,在Motion Bench [7],TOMATO的时间推理 [19],在SVCBench的流体状态维护 [14].
在TOMATO上,GPT-4o只正确回答36.0%的计数问题[19].
在SVCBench上,作者评价的每个模型仍然远远低于主要计数标准上人类的96.1,在定期活动上不超过11.1 [14].

blocks.en:
The difficulty lies between the frames.
A video-language model reasons over a few sampled frames [ 3 ] , whereas each repetition of an action is a cycle of movement that unfolds between them.
When an action repeats quickly, consecutive frames can skip whole repetitions, and no frame records how many were skipped.
Dedicated repetition counters recover this temporal structure through temporal self-similarity in RepNet [ 4 ] , multi-scale temporal correlation in TransRAC [ 9 ] , or exemplar correspondence in ESCounts [ 21 ] , and CountLLM [ 26 ] brings repetition counting into a language model through multimodal training.
These counters are dedicated models trained to count repeated actions, whereas the counting questions of video-language benchmarks are answered by general models that must also decide what to count.
blocks.zh:
困难在于框架之间。
一个视频语言模型在几个抽样帧上的原因[3],而每次重复一个动作都是在它们之间展开的运动周期.
当一个动作迅速重复时,相继的帧可以跳过全部重复,没有帧记录有多少被跳过.
专用的重复计数器通过RepNet [4] 中的时间自相仿性,TransRAC [9] 中多尺度的时间相关性,或ESCounts [21] 中的例子通信来恢复这种时间结构,而CounterLLM [26] 通过多模式培训将重复计数带入语言模型.
这些计数器是训练有素的专用模型,可以计算重复行动,而视频语言基准的计数问题则由一般模型回答,而这些模型也必须决定计数内容.

blocks.en:
Video codecs already record the movement between frames.
To compress a video, the encoder predicts image blocks from reference frames and stores a signed displacement, the motion vector, for each prediction.
Recent video models exploit this structure as input: Video-LaVIT [ 10 ] and CoPE-VideoLM [ 18 ] learn motion tokens, EMA [ 32 ] aggregates motion vectors within each group of pictures, and OneVision-Encoder [ 22 ] selects visual patches by codec saliency.
In each case, the codec changes what the model sees, so the motion vectors reach the count only through learned visual features.
blocks.zh:
视频解码器已经记录了帧之间的移动.
为了压缩视频,编码器从参考框中预测出图像块并存储一个已签名的位移,运动向量,用于每个预测.
近期的视频模型利用这种结构作为输入:Video-LaVIT [10]和CPE-VideoLM [18] 学习运动符号,EMA [32] 聚合各组图片内的运动向量,而One Vision-Encoder [22] 以可编码的显著性选择视觉补丁.
在每一种情况下,解码器都会改变模型所看到的,所以运动向量只能通过所学到的视觉特征来到达计数.

blocks.en:
We show that codec motion can do more than shape the input: it provides direct evidence for the count.
A candidate count is itself a testable hypothesis about the motion.
For a repeated movement, a proposed number of cycles predicts how the observed directions are organized over time.
Unwinding those cycles and measuring the organization of the residual directions tests this prediction without detecting individual events, and assigns every integer a score that we call the count potential ( ).
blocks.zh:
我们显示编码运动能做的不只是塑造输入:它为计数提供了直接的证据.
候选人数本身就是对运动的可验证假设.
对于反复的移动,拟议的若干个周期预测了观测到的方向在一段时间内是如何排列的.
解除这些循环,测量剩余方向的组织,在不检测个别事件的情况下测试这种预测,并给每个整数分配一个我们称之为计数潜力的分数(.).

blocks.en:
Diffusion vision-language models (dVLMs) such as LaViDa [ 13 ] , Dream-VL [ 28 ] , and VidLaDA [ 6 ] offer a natural place for this evidence.
They produce an answer by iterative denoising.
At every step, the model scores all unresolved answer positions with bidirectional context and commits a subset of them.
A count therefore stays open while the answer forms, and evidence that enters during denoising can still decide it.
An autoregressive model, by contrast, commits the first digit of a count before the remaining digits exist, so evidence about the complete number cannot reach that decision.
blocks.zh:
传播视觉语言模型(dVLM),如"LaViDa"[13],"梦-VL"[28],"VidLADA"[6],为这种证据提供了自然之地.
他们通过迭代发音来产生一个答案.
在每一个步骤,模型都会给所有有双向上下文的未解决的答案位置打分,并承担其中的一个子集.
因此,在回答表格中,一个计数保持开放,在解密期间输入的证据仍然可以决定。
相形之下,一个自旋式模型在剩余数位存在之前,就承诺一个数的第一位数,因此关于完整数的证据无法达到这个决定.

blocks.en:
We introduce CoDiCount, a unified training-free framework for count-level conditioning of a frozen dVLM.
CoDiCount evaluates the potential on a motion-progress clock that advances with accumulated movement rather than wall time, so the hypothesized cycles follow the measured movement through pauses and changes of speed. Structured count messages then bring the potential into every denoising step by mapping public option letters, or the grammar-valid edits of the current integer draft, to the counts they express and reweighting the model’s own probabilities within that set.
The model’s recognition thus decides what is counted, and the codec motion tests how many.
In the full Dream-VL implementation, the messages join codec-selected visual memory, temporal contrast, and soft feedback in one inference loop, so the codec shapes both what the model sees and which count it commits.
All model weights stay frozen, and the count messages connect codec measurements directly to the number being generated without adding any forward pass.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了CoDiCount, 一个统一的无培训框架,用于一个被冻结的dVLM的计数级调节.
CoDiCount评价一个运动进度时钟上的潜力,该时钟以累积的运动时间而不是墙壁时间来推进,因此所假设的周期通过暂停和速度变化来跟踪所测量的运动. 结构化的计数信息然后通过绘制公共选项字母,或者对当前整数草稿的语法验证编辑,将潜力带入每一个去命名步骤,以达到它们表达的计数,并在该套数中重新加权模型本身的概率。
因此,模型的识别决定了什么是计数,编码运动测试了多少.
在"Dream-VL"的完整执行中,消息会加入代码所选择的视觉内存,时间对比,以及一个推断回路中的软反馈,因此代码既会塑造模型所看到的,又会算出它所承诺的.
所有模型权重都保持被冻结,计数信息将编码测量直接连接到正在生成的数字上而无需添加任何前传.

blocks.en:
Applied to two dVLMs with different decoders, Dream-VL and LaViDa, CoDiCount outperforms the official decoders of both models on all three benchmarks, raising MotionBench accuracy from 23.0% to 57.5% on Dream-VL and from 23.2% to 55.2% on LaViDa, and LaViDa’s SVCBench score by half.
On SVCBench periodic activities, it lifts the GPA of Dream-VL from 0.0 to 66.1.
Our contributions are as follows: • We are the first to use codec motion as direct evidence for the count, testing every candidate integer as a cycle hypothesis through motion progress and phase-marginalized directional organization ( Secs. 3.1 and 3.2 ). • Our unified training-free framework, CoDiCount, brings this evidence into every denoising step of a frozen dVLM through structured count messages ( Secs. 3.3 and 3.4 ). • Without any training, CoDiCount generalizes broadly across diffusion models, datasets, and diverse counting tasks, and lets a 7B dVLM surpass GPT-5.1 and Gemini-2.5-Pro on MotionBench and GPT-4o on TOMATO, and match GPT-5.4 on SVCBench ( Sec. 4 ).

关于SVCBench的定期活动,它将Dream-VL的GPA从0.0提高到66.1.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Class-agnostic repetition counters learn periodicity from annotated or synthetic repetitions: RepNet [ 4 ] through temporal self-similarity, TransRAC [ 9 ] through multi-scale temporal correlations, context-aware counting [ 29 ] through coarse-to-fine cycle refinement, and ESCounts [ 21 ] through exemplar correspondence.
Other counters add audio [ 30 ] , salient poses [ 25 ] , or open-vocabulary targets [ 5 ] , and CountLLM [ 26 ] trains a multimodal language model with periodic representations.
These methods are dedicated counters trained to count the repetitions of an action.
CoDiCount instead strengthens the general video-language models that answer counting questions: the question decides what is counted, and codec evidence for every candidate count, obtained without any training, tests how many.
blocks.zh:
类不可知重复计数器从附加说明或合成重复中学习周期性:RepNet [4]通过时间自相仿,TransRAC [9]通过多尺度时间相关性,上下文感知计数 [29]通过粗细至细周期的完善,ESCounts [21]通过实例对应.
其他计数器会增加音频 [30],显著表示 [25],或开放-vobulary目标 [5],而CounterLLM [26] 训练一种具有定期表达功能的多模式语言模型.
这些方法是专门训练的计数器,用来计算重复的行动。
CoDiCount转而加强一般视频语言模型,以回答计数问题:问题决定计数内容,以及每个候选人计数,在没有经过任何培训的情况下获得的编码证据,测试人数.

blocks.en:
MotionBench [ 7 ] , TOMATO [ 19 ] , and SVCBench [ 14 ] test counting within motion understanding, temporal reasoning, and streaming state maintenance, with units that range from repeated cycles to objects, identities, and complete episodes.
Counting remains far from solved on these tests, both for open models trained by video instruction tuning, such as LLaVA-Video [ 31 ] , and for proprietary models, and CoDiCount applies one training-free potential across all of these settings.
blocks.zh:
Motion Bench [7],TOMATO [19],和SVCBench [14] 测试在运动理解,时间推理和流状态维护范围内进行计数,其单位范围从重复循环到物体,身份,以及完整事件.
计算还远远没有解决这些测试问题,无论是通过视频指导调制培训的开放模型,如LLaVA-Video[31],还是专有模型,CoDiCount在所有这些设置中都应用一种无培训的潜力。

blocks.en:
Compressed-domain recognition uses motion vectors and residuals as efficient inputs, from CoViAR [ 24 ] to the flow-supervised motion cues of DMC-Net [ 20 ] .
Recent video-language models bring codec structure into their visual input: Video-LaVIT [ 10 ] and CoPE-VideoLM [ 18 ] learn motion tokens, EMA [ 32 ] aggregates codec features within groups of pictures, and OneVision-Encoder [ 22 ] and AdaCodec [ 8 ] allocate visual tokens from coding structure.
In all of these methods, the codec decides what the model sees.
CoDiCount is the first to turn codec motion into direct evidence for the count: its integer-indexed potential scores every numerical hypothesis and acts on the answer of a frozen model.
blocks.zh:
压缩域识别使用运动向量和剩余作为高效输入,从CoViAR[24]到DMC-Net[20]的流量监督运动提示.
近期的视频-语言模型将代码结构带入了他们的视觉输入:Video-LaVIT [10]和CPE-VideoLM [18] 学习运动符号,EMA [32] 汇总了图片组内的代码特征,而OneVision-Encoder [22]和AdaCodec [8] 从编码结构中分配了可视符号.
在所有这些方法中,由解码器决定模型所看到的.
CoDiCount是第一个将代码运动转化为计数的直接证据:它的整数指数潜在分数每个数值假说和对被冻结模型的答案的行为.

blocks.en:
Discrete diffusion generates by iterative denoising [ 1 , 17 , 2 ] , and LLaDA [ 15 ] and Dream [ 27 ] scale it to instruction-following language models.
LaViDa [ 13 ] , Dream-VL [ 28 ] , and VidLaDA [ 6 ] extend it to images and video, keeping every unresolved answer position open across denoising steps.
Training-free decoding methods such as contrastive decoding [ 12 , 16 ] and geometry-aware soft tokens [ 11 ] improve how these models use their visual input or commit tokens, and the Dream-VL instantiation of CoDiCount builds on both.
CoDiCount adds evidence about the count itself, conditioning the evolving token alternatives on the counts they express at every denoising step.
blocks.zh:
通过迭代去音 [1, 17, 2] 和 LLaDA [15] 和 Dream [27] 将其缩放为遵循教学的语言模型而产生分层传播.
LaViDa [13], Dream-VL [28],和VidLADA [6] 将其扩展至图像和视频,使每个未解答的答题位置在发音步骤之间保持开放.
诸如对比解码[12,16]和几何-知音软符等无培训解码方法[11]改进了这些模型如何使用其视觉输入或承诺活符,CoDiCount的Dream-VL即时解码基于两者.
CoDiCount补充了有关计数本身的证据,将不断演变的代币替代物以它们在每个去名步骤上表达的计数为条件.

blocks.en: 3 Codec Motion as Count Evidence
blocks.zh: 3 代码动议作为伯爵证据

blocks.en:
Video counting determines a compact numerical answer from dense temporal evidence.
Diffusion vision-language models (dVLMs) offer a natural interface for this evidence, because their unresolved answer positions can be conditioned jointly and refined across denoising steps.
CoDiCount, a unified training-free framework for count-level conditioning , connects the two by keeping codec evidence in count space and conditioning the evolving answer on it.
A count potential ℓ ⁡ ( n ) \ell(n) tests each candidate integer against the observed motion ( Secs. 3.1 and 3.2 ), and structured count messages translate this evidence into coordinated updates of the answer tokens ( Sec. 3.3 ).
The inference loop then carries the conditioned predictions through denoising with codec-selected visual memory, temporal guidance, and soft feedback ( Secs. 3.4 and 2 ).

视频计数从密集的时间证据中确定一个紧凑的数字答案.
传播视觉语言模型(dVLMs)为这种证据提供了一个天然的界面,因为其尚未解决的答案位置可以共同设定条件,并通过去名步骤加以完善.
CoDiCount是计算级别条件的统一无培训框架,通过在计数空间中保存可编码证据并调节其上不断发展的答案来连接两者.

blocks.en:

blocks.en: 4.1 Evaluation protocol

blocks.en:
We evaluate the public Repetition Count questions of MotionBench [ 7 ] , the Action Count questions of TOMATO [ 19 ] , and the complete SVCBench [ 14 ] with all eight counting categories.
MotionBench and TOMATO are multiple-choice with four to six options and span gaming, industrial, medical, sports, human, object, and simulated videos.
SVCBench asks for an open integer after every prefix of a stream and covers event counting (actions, transitions, episodes, and periodic activities) and object counting.

Motion Bench和TOMATO是多选择,有4到6个选项,并跨游戏,工业,医疗,体育,人类,物体,和模拟视频.
SVCBench要求在一个流的每个前缀后都有一个开放的整数,并覆盖事件计数(动作,过渡,事件,和周期活性)和对象计数.

blocks.en:
We apply CoDiCount to two diffusion vision-language models with different backbones, vision encoders, and decoders, and compare each with its official decoder.
For Dream-VL-7B [ 28 ] , the baseline is the unmodified official generator.
For LaViDa [ 13 ] , both arms run the model’s native hard-commit decoder with 32 frames, 32 answer slots, and 16 denoising steps, and CoDiCount adds only the count potential and messages to its answer logits.
On Dream-VL, CoDiCount runs the complete inference loop of Sec. 3.4 with 32 language-model calls per answer, and on LaViDa it uses the native 17 calls of its host.

blocks.en:
CoDiCount consistently outperforms the official decoders of both models on all three benchmarks.
On Dream-VL, accuracy rises from 23.0% to 57.5% on MotionBench and from 31.5% to 43.2% on TOMATO, and SVCBench GPA rises from 26.4 to 29.1.
On LaViDa, accuracy rises from 23.2% to 55.2% on MotionBench and from 17.8% to 30.5% on TOMATO, and SVCBench GPA rises from 15.1 to 22.8.
The same count potential and messages thus serve a guided decoder with soft feedback and a native hard-commit decoder, without any change.
blocks.zh:
CoDiCount在所有三个基准上都一直比这两个模型的官方解码器要好.
在Dream-VL上,Motion Bench的精度从23.0%上升到57.5%,TOMATO上的精度从31.5%上升到43.2%,而SVCBench GPA的精度从26.4%上升到29.1%.
在拉维达,Motion Bench的精度从23.2%上升到55.2%,TOMATO的精度从17.8%上升到30.5%,而SVCBench GPA的精度从15.1%上升到22.8%.
因此,同样的计数潜力和消息为一个有软反馈的指导解码器和本地硬承诺解码器服务,没有任何改变。

blocks.en:
Without any training, CoDiCount lets 7B and 8B diffusion models count at the level of much larger and newer autoregressive models.
On MotionBench, Dream-VL with CoDiCount reaches 57.5%, above Gemini-2.5-Pro (57.0%), GPT-5.1 (56.7%), and Claude-Opus-4.5 (36.9%) on the official leaderboard, and LaViDa with CoDiCount reaches 55.2%, above every listed open model up to 106B ( Tab. 1 ).
On TOMATO, Dream-VL with CoDiCount reaches 43.2%, above every model in Tab. 2 , including Gemini-1.5-Pro (36.3%), GPT-4o (36.0%), and LLaVA-Video-72B [ 31 ] (34.6%).
On SVCBench, its GPA of 29.1 matches GPT-5.4 (29.1) and exceeds Kimi-K2.5 (26.4), Qwen3-VL-30B (27.0), InternVL-3.5-8B (24.2), and the streaming models ( Tab. 3 ).
The lead is largest on periodic activities, where the count is a number of repeated movements: Dream-VL with CoDiCount reaches a GPA of 66.1, against 3.2 for GPT-5.4, and exceeds the strongest evaluated model, LiveStar (11.1), by 55.0.
These gains come from evidence that the sampled frames do not contain: the motion between them, tested against every candidate count.

blocks.en: 4.3 Generalization across counting categories
blocks.zh: 4.3 跨计数类别的概括

blocks.en:
The gains generalize across counting categories.
On MotionBench, every category improves on both models ( Tab. 4 ), and the largest gains occur where the counted unit is a repeated movement: Gaming rises from 21.7% to 90.8% on Dream-VL and from 27.0% to 93.4% on LaViDa.
On TOMATO, human actions rise from 14.0% to 70.2% and from 3.5% to 45.6%, and on SVCBench, periodic activities, which neither official decoder counts correctly, reach a GPA of 66.1 on Dream-VL and 26.6 on LaViDa.
Together with the transfer from Dream-VL to LaViDa, these results demonstrate the broad generalization of count-level conditioning across models, answer formats, and counting categories.
blocks.zh:
收益概括到各种计数类别。
在Motion Bench上,每个类别在两种模型上都有改进(Tab. 4),最大的增益发生在被计数的单位是重复运动的情况下: 游戏在Dream-VL上从21.7%上升到90.8%,在LaViDa上从27.0%上升到93.4%.
在TOMATO上,人类行动从14.0%上升到70.2%,从3.5%上升到45.6%;在SVCBench上,定期活动,无论是官方解码器都无法正确计算,在Dream-VL和LaViDa上达到66.1的GPA和26.6的GPA。
这些结果与从Dream-VL到LaViDa的转录一起,表明计数级调制在模型,答题格式,计数类中的广泛概括.

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablations

blocks.en: We ablate CoDiCount on Dream-VL, where all variants share the frozen model, the inputs, the inference loop, and 32 language-model calls per answer ( Tab. 5 ).

blocks.en:
Removing the count potential and structured count messages from the complete loop lowers accuracy from 57.5% to 26.0% on MotionBench and from 43.2% to 28.1% on TOMATO, and SVCBench GPA from 29.1 to 24.1.
The count evidence thus drives the gains of CoDiCount within its inference loop.

从完整的循环中去除计数潜力和结构化计数信息,使Motion Bench的精度从57.5%降至26.0%,TOMATO的精度从43.2%降至28.1%,SVCBench GPA从29.1%降至24.1%.
因此,计数证据促使CoDiCount在推论圈内获利。

blocks.en:
The count potential reads cycles from the order of the motion.
Permuting the codec vectors over time, while keeping their values, timestamps, and support, lowers GPA to 24.2, the level without count messages, and MoC from 68.9 to 58.8.
This confirms the central idea of CoDiCount: the count evidence lies in the temporal organization of the codec motion, not in its amount or the distribution of its directions.
blocks.zh:
计数潜力从运动顺序读取周期.
使编码向量随时间而变化,同时保持其值、时间戳和支持,将GPA降至24.2,即无计数消息的级别;将MOC从68.9降至58.8。
这证实了CoDiCount的中心思想:计数证据在于编码运动的时间组织,而不是其数量或方向的分配.

blocks.en:
Applying the same messages only once, at the last denoising step, when most answer positions are already committed, lowers GPA to 25.8.
Count evidence must therefore enter while the answer is still open, as it does at every step of the iterative denoising of a dVLM.

在最后的解密步骤中,当大多数答复立场已经承诺时,只应用一次相同的信息,将GPA降至25.8。
因此,在解答尚未解开时,必须输入计数证据,如同在DVLM迭代去名的每个步骤一样。

blocks.en:
Restricting the messages to single-token edits lowers GPA to 26.2 overall and from 66.1 to 16.7 on periodic activities, whose larger counts often need several answer tokens to change at once.
The structured messages are therefore what make large open-integer counts reachable.

因此,结构化的信息使得大型的开集计数可以达到。

blocks.en: 4.5 Efficiency and extensions
blocks.zh: 4.5 效率和延长

blocks.en:
The count potential and messages are lightweight: they add no language-model or vision-encoder forward passes to their host.
Codec fields are exported once per video and reused by every query on it, and the export compresses raw codec data by roughly 500 times into compact fields.
The count potential is computed once per query, and the messages operate on the logits of the count-bearing positions only.

计数潜力和消息都是轻量级的:它们没有给主机添加语言模型或视觉编码器前传通行证.
代码字段每段视频导出一次,再由每个查询重用,导出时将原始代码数据压缩约500倍入收缩字段.
计数潜力每次查询一次计算,消息只在计数位置的日志上运行.

blocks.en:
The count potential measures cycles of motion direction, while the question and the dVLM’s visual interpretation decide what is counted.
The same count-level interface can host potentials built from other codec signals, such as residuals or block types, to bring identity and grouping evidence into the answer as well.
blocks.zh:
计数潜在测量运动方向的循环,而问题和dVLM的视觉解释决定了计数.
相同的计数层接口可以容纳由其他编码信号所构建的潜力,例如剩余或块类型,从而也将身份和证据分组到答案中去.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We have shown, for the first time, that the motion recorded by video codecs between sampled frames provides direct evidence for video counting at the level of the generated answer.
CoDiCount tests each candidate count against codec motion on a motion-progress clock and brings the resulting potential into denoising through messages on the tokens that express each count.
Without any training, this count-level conditioning generalizes broadly across diffusion models, datasets, and diverse counting tasks.
It lets a 7B dVLM count better than GPT-5.1 and Gemini-2.5-Pro on MotionBench and GPT-4o on TOMATO, and on par with GPT-5.4 on SVCBench, where it leads every evaluated model on periodic activities.
Its gains come from the temporal order of the codec motion and from evidence that takes part in the iterations that form the answer.
These results establish the codec as a new source of evidence for video understanding, and the same count-level interface can host potentials from other codec signals, such as residuals and block types, to capture identity and event structure.

With supplementary features, equal positive and negative feature arrays trigger the identity guidance path.
Without supplementary features, the inherited zero-gate rule triggers it.
The implementation represents the guidance mask by the smallest finite BF16 value, numerically suppressing blocked alternatives.
Potential evaluation and token-domain planning require no model forward passes.
The two visual branches and supplementary image encoding are costs of the full Dream system and are retained in its matched ablation.
